title: Success rate and complications of Bollard-modified miniplates for bone-anchored maxillary protraction in growing patients: A single-surgeon retrospective cohort study
html: The objective of this study was to evaluate the success rate, stability, and complications of Bollard-modified miniplate anchorage for bone-anchored maxillary protraction (BAMP) in a large cohort of growing patients treated by a single surgeon with long-term follow-up.
